rows.en: I've decided to go back to the Naager! It's true! I won't resist either!
Ryoko…

I see, I've figured it out!

You'll get us to drop our guard by saying you're coming back to the Naager, and then make me lift the Dimensional Distortion Field barrier, right?

Hah hah hah… What a joke! Even Lucifard, the Jet-Black Knight, has really lost his edge, hasn't he?
[HERO2]…

Fadita! What a disgrace, with you by his side!

And Lord Zephas is no better! Doting on a spineless man like this…

Atefarina! That's enough chatter!

The Naager is ready for takeoff! There's no need to linger… We're returning to the ship, Atefarina!
Takeoff…? What are you planning?
Heh heh heh… It's too late! The Earth's fate has already been decided.
What!? What do you mean?
I mean that the Gaia Project of our Battle Fleet Nation Naager… no, of Lord Steel Emperor Zephas, is already in motion.
The Gaia Project…?

The Naager's hull tentacles have reached the Earth's ore deposits and extracted uranium from all kinds of minerals containing iron elements!

Spending weeks at it, ever since we put down roots here…

I see…!

So that's why you've been so quiet these past few days? What are you plotting with the Gaia Project!?

Heh heh heh…

If we irradiate it with neutrons in the Naager's power reactor and return it to the ore deposits, what do you suppose will happen to this Earth?

Nuclear fission would spread over a wide area from the center of the Earth… …!?

The Earth itself would become something like a bomb…!

Its power would be the Earth's mass times the speed of light squared… The Earth itself would truly become the ultimate weapon of slaughter.

Nuclear fission would spread over a wide area from the center of the Earth… …!?

The Earth itself would become something like a bomb…!

Its power would be the Earth's mass times the speed of light squared… The Earth itself would truly become the ultimate weapon of slaughter.

Exactly! Turning this Earth into a gigantic bomb… that is the Gaia Project!

Mankind will suffer the Earth's retribution! In place of the silent Earth, Lord Steel Emperor Zephas will pass judgment on all mankind!
That's insane!? As if you could do something like that!

Receiving data from the command satellite's crustal movement monitoring system!!

…!?

[HERO2]! For the past few weeks, unexplained tremors have been continuing all around the foot of Mt. Fuji!

Receiving data from the command satellite's crustal movement monitoring system!!

…!?

[HERO2]! For the past few weeks, unexplained tremors have been continuing all around the foot of Mt. Fuji!

As expected of Fadita…

Deep beneath this Fuji volcano lie minerals in abundance, enough to push the plan to its highest stage…

In flashy style… you'll vanish without a single scrap of your flesh left! Hah hah hah…
I won't forgive you! I'll never forgive you!! I won't let you do this!

Oh, my… What a quick change of mood!

So you've finally shown your true colors? Lucifard! Lord Steel Emperor Zephas ordered me to bring you back alive, but…

well, unfortunately, it looks like I'll be reporting that you were already dead.

I told you, didn't I? The name "Battle Princess" isn't just for show!

I'll make sure you can never pull a cheeky farce like this again! Fusion Steel, equip!!

If you insist on fighting, so be it…

Just don't waste any time! Hurry back to the ship! Understood?

Mind your own business!

I'll teach him plenty about what it means to truly master Fusion Steel!
Bring it on! Fusion Steel, equip!!

Ugh…

[HERO2]…?

[HERO2]!!

Could it be!? Atefarina… Lady Ryoko has been freed from the Naager's curse too?
Ryoko!!

Excessive shock to the body's metal core…

It seems that's one way to escape the mental control of Fusion Steel… no, of the Vol cells…
Ryoko… you'd better not talk too much! The TDF-affiliated hospital could…

Life signs, faint… Fusion Steel, shifting to life-support mode…

Shift… impossible!? Why?
What is it? [HERO4]… What about my sister? What about her…?

It's no use…

The damage to her life-support system is too severe. Lady Atefarina is already…
N-no… Sis! Ryoko!!

Ugh… At the very end… I'm glad… I got to see you as your sister…

[HERO2]… our family has done something we can never undo… ugh… something we can never take back…

[HERO2]… it's your duty to open the eyes of Steel Emperor Zepha… no, of Father, to his delusion.
I know… I know, Sis!

Father… means to destroy the Earth by turning it into a bomb, with the Gaia Project…

At the same time… he intends to spread Dimensional Distortion Fields… ugh… across the entire universe…

Controlling Dimensional Distortion Fields, which can teleport anything in an instant… would let him send invaders anywhere…

Father… wants to watch every living thing slowly rot away, filled with pain and despair…

I've lifted the Space Fortress Naager's barrier… …Now you should be able to achieve your goal… ugh…

Ah… Even if his mind… is controlled by Vol… by the Vol cells… you mustn't let our father… do such a thing…
I promise, Sis… I'll never let Father do that! Even if I have to take him down with me…

…!?

No… you mustn't think like that… no…

[HERO2]… let me talk with Fadita for a little while…
With [HERO4]…?
I made Fadita's "heart." She's another me, so to speak… At the end… let the two of us talk alone…

All right…

[HERO4], take care of my sister…
You've served [HERO2] so well, haven't you? Thank you, Fadita…
Lady Atefarina…

Do you know… why your name is [HERO4]?

Heh heh… [HERO4] is the name of our late mother…

Cough… cough…
Lady Atefarina… please, hang on!
I'm finished… You can tell, can't you?

Say…?

Do you love [HERO2]?

…………!

You know very well, Lady Atefarina, that an organic droid like me couldn't possibly understand such feelings.

That's right…

Of course…
But… I will serve [HERO2]! Now and always…

Ugh… Thank you…

One last thing… I have a request for you.

Access… the memory circuit of my Fusion Steel… and copy… "SS0321/42"…
…Understood! Beginning access!

You are… the finest of all the organic droids I've made…

Truly my finest work…

Copy complete…

Decompressing and saving to memory circuit!

…!?

Th-this is…!

…………

Understood! I will carry it out without fail. Lady Ryoko…

I'm truly… truly sorry…

But… you're the only one… I can ask…

…Thank… you…

"Lady Ryoko…

please, rest assured… and rest in peace…"

Atefarina the Battle Princess died having regained her human heart at the very end… The girl with a made heart said farewell to the remains, holding in her heart the words entrusted to her by her creator…

A breach opened in the impregnable fortress… a road to victory, opened at the cost of a precious sacrifice! Inheriting his sister's heart, Lucifard resolved to fight the father who had been taken over by madness…
[HERO4], the Space Sheriffs are assembling! Leave it to Annie!

The top executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker were always cyborgs!

And you're probably one too… Show your true form!!

The top executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker were always cyborgs!

And you're probably one too… Show your true form!!

Our Destron has joined hands with the Battle Fleet Nation Naager to carry out the Operation to Annihilate Japan!

Shiro Kazami… no, Kamen Rider V3! And your foolish friends! I'll dispose of you all together! Gwaaaah…

Heh heh heh… Now, I wonder about that.

Maybe it's the Naager that's being used, after all? Subjugation!
Ultraman… it's too soon for you to fall! Now, stand up!

Zoffy!

The first Ultraman, and Ultraseven! I thought you both went back to the Land of Ultra…?

It's all right now…

Now, let's fight for the Earth! The Ultra Brothers, joining forces…
Having lost Velvet… leaving Vortex behind at the bottom of despair, the situation took a sudden turn!

And…?

The assault team… did those Amigo folks succeed in infiltrating the Space Fortress Naager?

Sir…

They succeeded!

The barrier was lifted, and some units succeeded in breaking in. We believe they're currently in combat inside the space fortress.

According to what the Space Sheriffs reported to Commander Kom after storming the Fushigi Palace in pursuit of the Fushigi World Fuuma…

the Space Fortress Naager has been cultivating Vol cells in the Earth's ore deposits.
What!? They were using the Earth's ore deposits as a laboratory!?
I see… That makes sense…

Well… Vol cells are a type of archaeal cell…

As the name suggests, they're rare cells that haven't evolved since the Earth's most ancient environment, and their ecology resembles that of slime molds in some ways.

If you were to cultivate them on today's Earth, it would be in the ore deposits of undersea volcanoes or active volcanic zones…
A nest of Vol cells, you might say…
But… what on earth do they plan to do by cultivating Vol cells?
Why? Why attack the Earth?

Well…

My mentor, Dr. Hinata, had a theory that that Number Ten was also a living being…

Sadly, Dr. Hinata died in an accident during his research, but if his hypothesis was correct…

then Number Ten is unmistakably a living being, and you could even say it was our Earth that suddenly appeared before it.

uncertain: U15703: 漆黒の騎士ルシファード rendered 'Lucifard, the Jet-Black Knight' (glossary has 'Black Knight Lucifard' for 黒騎士).
U15715/U15716: 'mass times the speed of light squared' kept as in source (E=mc^2 reference).
U15721: 巳の肉片 read as 己の肉片 ('your flesh'); the target of '己' is ambiguous (the hero or everyone).
U15736: 章族 read as 一族/家族 ('our family'); 達えて read as 逢えて.
U15742: ［心］ brackets changed to quotes: Fadita's "heart".
U15746: [HERO4] is said to be the name of the siblings' late mother; translated as written.
U15757: narration row continues [HERO4]'s line (split row).
U15760-U15770: route where [HERO4] is the organic droid Fadita; narration kept literal.
U15770: narration opens with a quote mark but has no close in this row; translated as a full sentence.

new_names.why: variant of 黒騎士 (Black Knight), not in glossary
